Package org.a2aproject.sdk.server.util.sse

@NullMarked package org.a2aproject.sdk.server.util.sse
Server-Sent Events (SSE) formatting utilities for A2A streaming responses.

Provides framework-agnostic conversion of Flow.Publisher<A2AResponse<?>> to Flow.Publisher<String> with SSE formatting, enabling easy integration with any HTTP server framework (Vert.x, Jakarta Servlet, etc.).
